params.body:
The "Stel een vraag" modal on a vehicle page posted straight to `/api/lead/`, which forwarded every request to the platform's public lead endpoint. Each bot request became a lead in the garage's worklist plus a mail. The contact, appointment and test-drive forms already go through the traps in `src/lib/form-gate.ts`; this form did not.

## What changes

- `form-gate.ts`: a fifth form name, `vraag`, and `leadFields()`, which maps the modal's JSON body onto the fields `evaluate()` reads (`name` as `naam`, `message` as `bericht`, plus the three gate fields).
- `api/lead.ts`: evaluates the gate before calling the platform. A rejected lead gets the same `201` as a sent one, so a bot learns nothing; only the reason is logged.
- `VehicleDetail.astro`: the hidden honeypot, and the token fetched from `/api/form-token/?form=vraag` at page load, sent with the lead.

Same trade-off as the other forms: a submission without JavaScript, or within 4 seconds of page load, is dropped silently.

## Checked

- `vitest run`: 44 passed, four new cases for the lead (passes as the modal sends it; rejected without token, with honeypot, with another form's token, with links, too fast).
- `astro build` passes. `astro check` reports the same 19 errors as `main`, none added.

Closes #37
params.title: Put the spam gate in front of the vehicle question form
